name: Breadcrumbs
summary: Where am I, how did I get here, and how do I step back. A horizontal trail of links separated by ChevronRight, with the current page as the terminal non-link node. Truncates with an ellipsis menu when the trail exceeds the available width.

items.description: Sequence of <BreadcrumbItem> children. The last item should be marked aria-current='page' and rendered as plain text, not a link.

separator.description: Override the default lucide ChevronRight separator. Use a slash glyph for editorial / docs flows, a chevron for app trails.

maxItems.description: When the trail exceeds this count, middle items collapse into a single overflow ellipsis that opens a DropdownMenu listing the hidden links.

size.description: sm: type.label.sm + 4 px gap (operator default). md: type.label.md + 6 px gap (marketing default).

keyboard: Tab - move focus to next breadcrumb link
Shift+Tab - move focus to previous breadcrumb link
rules: Use an ordered list (<ol>) inside the nav so screen readers expose the position semantically.
Mark the current page with aria-current='page'. Render it as plain text, not a link.
Separators are decorative — wrap them in aria-hidden='true'.
Truncated middle items collapse into a single ellipsis button that opens a DropdownMenu — the menu items are full breadcrumb links.

do: Lead with the top-level destination, end with the current page.
Keep labels short — a node, not a sentence. 'Settings', not 'Account settings home'.
Use Title Case for navigation node names (matches the Navbar). Use sentence case if labels are derived from user content.
Truncate to an ellipsis menu past 4 nodes on desktop, past 3 on mobile.
Pair with the page title <h1> directly below — the breadcrumbs locate, the h1 names.
dont: Don't include the current page as a link — it points to itself.
Don't use Breadcrumbs as a stand-in for back navigation. The browser's back button serves that.
Don't render Breadcrumbs alongside a Stepper — they answer different questions ('where' vs 'how far'). Pick one.
Don't use Breadcrumbs on landing or marketing pages — they belong in app trails, not promo surfaces.
Don't paint separators in lime — they're chrome, not action. Use color.text.tertiary.

changelog.note: Initial Breadcrumbs contract. Truncate-to-DropdownMenu for trails past maxItems. aria-current='page' on the terminal node.
